title: Freeze schema v1 baseline with foreign keys and 0..1 constraints
lead: Pre-1.0 data loss is acceptable (owner decision). From 1.0 on, schema changes need explicit migrations.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- `exportSchema = false` and `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()`: any future bump silently wipes user data.
- `entries`/`targets`/`reminders` have no `ForeignKey`, so tracker delete (S16) would orphan rows.
- `targets`/`reminders` are 0..1 per tracker but have no unique index. The `REPLACE` conflict strategy never triggers because `id` is autogenerated.
- The repository loads every bundle to find one tracker (`getTrackerBundles().firstOrNull`, at :49, :69, :218).
- Entry insert and `bumpTracker` aren't in one transaction.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- AppDatabase.kt, TrackerModels.kt, TrackerDao.kt, TrackerRepository.kt
- app/build.gradle (Room `room.schemaLocation` kapt arg)
- app/schemas/ (new, committed)
- app/src/androidTest/.../TrackerDaoTest.kt (new; replaces ExampleInstrumentedTest)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
These are instrumented tests on an in-memory Room database:
- `deleting tracker cascades entries targets reminders`
- `second target for same tracker replaces first`
- `getTracker returns single row`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Add `ForeignKey(entity = TrackerEntity::class, parentColumns = ["id"], childColumns = ["trackerId"], onDelete = CASCADE)` to the three child entities. Make `Index("trackerId", unique = true)` on targets and reminders.
2. Reset to `version = 1`, set `exportSchema = true` with the kapt arg `room.schemaLocation=$projectDir/schemas`, and commit the JSON.
3. Keep the `fallbackToDestructiveMigration()` call only behind `BuildConfig.DEBUG`, and add a comment saying 1.0+ requires a `Migration`.
4. Add `@Query("SELECT * FROM trackers WHERE id = :id") suspend fun getTracker(id: Long): TrackerEntity?` and `deleteTracker`. Replace the three full-table scans.
5. Wrap `addEntry`/`updateEntry`/`deleteEntry` plus `bumpTracker` in `database.withTransaction`.
6. Update DEVELOPERS.md Persistence Notes to describe schema v1, exported schemas, and the migration policy.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest` passes on an emulator, API 34 or newer.
- `app/schemas/.../1.json` exists.
